name: BQML Agent Skills Test
description: Tests if the bq_ml_agent can generate a correct ARIMA_PLUS model creation query.

parts.text: I would like to train sales per product and store with time series column being date
The `ARIMA_PLUS` forecasting model has been successfully trained.

args.bqml_code:
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `arai-sandbox-327738.forecasting_sticker_sales.sales_forecast_model`
OPTIONS(
  MODEL_TYPE='ARIMA_PLUS',
  TIME_SERIES_TIMESTAMP_COL='date',
  TIME_SERIES_DATA_COL='num_sold',
  TIME_SERIES_ID_COL=['product', 'store']
) AS
SELECT
  date,
  product,
  store,
  num_sold
FROM
  `arai-sandbox-327738.forecasting_sticker_sales.train`
WHERE
  num_sold IS NOT NULL
